$comment: The three starting values the calibration scripts read (pdq.maxDistance, pdq.minQuality, verify.minInliers), copied from the API configuration as it was when the runs were made (2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25). Public values with their published sources; the API's other settings are not part of this repository.

maxDistance.source: ThreatExchange pdq/README.md: match threshold "<=31" Hamming bits (https://github.com/facebook/ThreatExchange/tree/main/pdq; read 23-24 Nov 2026, note 40 Phase 0). Also the largest distance the 16-band lookup is sure to find.

minQuality.source: ThreatExchange pdq/README.md: discard hashes of quality "<=49" (same source as maxDistance). A hash counts only when its quality is above this value.

minInliers.source: Kazempourradi et al., Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance, arXiv:2610.04151 (2 Oct 2026): geometric verification SIFT + RANSAC counts 12 inliers as a match (note 40, section 2).
